title: Glucagon and the liver-alpha-cell axis
text: Glucagon hepatic amino-acid metabolism form feedback loop known liver-alpha-cell axis. Circulating amino acids stimulate glucagon secretion alpha-cell proliferation; glucagon, turn, drives hepatic amino-acid catabolism ureagenesis. health, oral glucose load suppresses glucagon, limiting hepatic glucose output. Glucagon resistance describes breakdown loop, seen hepatic steatosis type 2 diabetes: liver responds less glucagon, amino acids glucagon rise (hyperglucagonaemia), glucose fails suppress glucagon normally. Non-suppression glucagon glucose recognized early feature dysglycaemia.

title: Insulin release indices: formulas and interpretation
text: HOMA-beta estimates steady-state basal beta-cell function. Higher values mean greater fasting insulin output; markedly high values often reflect compensatory hypersecretion face insulin resistance, low values suggest beta-cell insufficiency. undefined G0 approaches 3.5 mmol/L.

title: Insulin release indices: formulas and interpretation
text: meanG meanI row means glucose insulin across 0, 30 120 min. Interpretation. Cir (corrected insulin response) insulinogenic indices (Xinsdg30, Xinsg30) capture early-phase insulin response glucose; higher greater early secretion. Stumvoll Bigtt_air estimate first-phase / acute insulin release; higher means larger burst. Di Dibig disposition indices: insulin secretion scaled insulin sensitivity. healthy beta cell secretes body resistant, disposition index key measure whether secretion adequate prevailing sensitivity. Lower values indicate beta-cell failure compensate strong predictor progression type 2 diabetes.

title: Insulin release indices: formulas and interpretation
text: Di equation transcribed exactly reported Madsen (2024) index table: square root covers G0_mg x I0_uU, mean terms outside root numerator 1000. identical canonical Matsuda-based disposition index (single square root four terms, numerator 10000). keep -reported form results reproduce source exactly; need Matsuda-standard disposition index, compute separately.

text: Expected units: glucagon values pmol/L (another consistent molar unit), measured fasting (0 min), 30 min 120 min 75 g OGTT. Fasting_glucagon requires Glucagon0. title: Beta-Cell Insulin Release Indices — insulin_release
text: Required columns per category: fasting: "G0", "I0" ogtt: "G0", "I0", "G30", "I30", "G120", "I120", "sex", "bmi" Expected units: glucose (G0, G30, G120) mmol/L, insulin (I0, I30, I120) pmol/L, bmi kg/m^2, sex male indicator (male = 1, female = 0). BIGTT-AIR BIGTT-SI terms enter sex linear multiplier, value 1 treated female; females coded 2 handled correctly. Internally, insulin converted pmol/L microU/mL (value * 0.1667) glucose mmol/L mg/dL (value * 18) source formula derived units. required column missing, corresponding indices skipped warning; missing values within present column yield NA indices depend . Indices calculated: Homa_beta (fasting): HOMA-beta, estimate steady-state beta-cell function. Cir (ogtt): Corrected Insulin Response. Stumvoll (ogtt): Stumvoll first-phase insulin release index. Xinsdg30 (ogtt): insulinogenic index using 0-30 min glucose increment. Xinsg30 (ogtt): insulinogenic index using 30 min glucose value. Di (ogtt): Disposition Index, transcribed exactly reported Madsen (2024) index table: Xinsg30 * 1000 / (sqrt(G0_mgdl * I0_uU) * meanG_mgdl * meanI_uU). Bigtt_air (ogtt): BIGTT Acute Insulin Response. Dibig (ogtt): Disposition Index (Bigtt_air-based).
